label: Multiple sclerosis
why: The rule's top picks come from one paper that split the genome into an HLA-only score (12 variants) and a non-HLA score; the HLA region carries the largest single genetic effect on MS, so a whole-genome score is the fairer single summary.

label: Age-related macular degeneration
why: The rule's pick is the same paper's score trained in African-ancestry samples; this is its European-trained twin with the same evaluation. Swap if your Ancestry section shows a different closest population.
